title: Manifest

args.description: Literal process arguments; never interpreted by a shell.

capabilities.description: Requested capabilities; requesting alone never grants access.

config_schema.description: Optional JSON Schema path relative to this package.

config_version.description: Configuration format version; omitted versions retain version one.

dependencies.description: Provider plugin IDs mapped to mandatory SemVer requirements.

entrypoint.description: Relative executable path inside the package; no parent components.

host_api.description: SemVer requirement that must match host API `0.1.0`.

protocol_version.description: IPC protocol major version; currently exactly one.

required_capabilities.description: Requested capabilities that must also be granted before loading.

target.description: Certified OS/architecture pair. Omission preserves legacy, uncertified packages.
